stem: What does the picture demonstrate about light?
instruction: A thin beam of light is shown in this picture.

options.label: A
options.text: Light and its reflections travel in straight lines.

options.label: B
options.text: Light cannot reflect from more than one surface.

options.label: C
options.text: Light that goes through water cannot travel in straight lines.

options.label: D
options.text: Light can travel in a circular path.
